scenarios.criterion: An app under test exposes window.__SATURDAY_CESIUM__ = { viewer, Cesium } and attaches saturdayMetadata (id, name, kind) to each entity it wants tests to find, as documented in the package's own README seam contract.
scenarios.name: Fixture page exposes the Cesium seam for test discovery
given: an app under test has loaded a page with a Cesium Viewer
when: the app follows the package's seam contract to attach the viewer and tag entities
then: window.__SATURDAY_CESIUM__ exposes the viewer and the Cesium namespace
every entity the app wants tests to find carries saturdayMetadata with an id, a name, and a kind

scenarios.criterion: packages/saturday-playwright-cesium/fixtures/ serves a static page with a Cesium Viewer on a spherical ellipsoid of a declared radius, one equirectangular image covering the whole globe from the package's own files, baseLayerPicker/geocoder/ion imagery off, known point/line/circle entities carrying metadata, and makes no request off its own origin.
scenarios.name: Fixture page renders a self-contained globe with known tagged entities
given: the fixture's static page is requested
then: the globe uses a spherical ellipsoid of the fixture's declared radius
the globe's whole surface is covered by one equirectangular image served from the package's own files
baseLayerPicker, geocoder, and ion imagery are all off
a point, a line, and a circle entity each carry saturdayMetadata, plus one entity whose kind is not a recognized value
one additional point entity carries no saturdayMetadata
no request made while loading the page leaves the page's own origin

scenarios.criterion: cesium.waitForSettled() resolves once the globe's tiles are loaded, the camera has stopped, and no render is pending, and rejects with a message naming the stuck condition (tiles/camera/render/seam) after a timeout.
scenarios.name: waitForSettled resolves once tiles, camera, and render are stable
given: the fixture page has loaded and the Cesium seam is present
when: the globe finishes loading tiles, the camera stops moving, and no render is pending, and the test calls cesium.waitForSettled()
then: the call resolves

scenarios.criterion: cesium.waitForSettled() resolves once the globe's tiles are loaded, the camera has stopped, and no render is pending, and rejects with a message naming the stuck condition (tiles/camera/render/seam) after a timeout.
scenarios.name: waitForSettled rejects naming the camera as the stuck condition
given: the fixture page has loaded and the Cesium seam is present
the camera is forced to appear still moving
when: the test calls cesium.waitForSettled() and waits past the timeout
then: the call rejects with a message that names the camera as the condition preventing settlement

scenarios.criterion: cesium.getEntities() returns each saturdayMetadata-tagged entity's metadata and geometry in degrees and metres: point position, line endpoints, circle centre and radius.
scenarios.name: getEntities returns metadata and geometry for every tagged entity
given: the fixture page has loaded with its tagged point, line, circle, and unrecognized-kind entities, plus one untagged point
then: the result includes each tagged entity's saturdayMetadata
the point entity's position is reported in degrees
the line entity's endpoints are reported in degrees
the circle entity's centre is reported in degrees and its radius in metres
the entity whose kind is not a recognized value is still included with its geometry
the untagged entity is not included in the result

scenarios.criterion: cesium.toScreen(lat, lng) returns page coordinates, or null when the point is on the far side of the globe or off-screen.
scenarios.name: toScreen returns page coordinates for a point facing the camera
given: the fixture page has loaded with the camera looking at a known location
when: the test calls cesium.toScreen(lat, lng) for a point facing the camera
then: it returns the point's page coordinates

scenarios.criterion: cesium.toScreen(lat, lng) returns page coordinates, or null when the point is on the far side of the globe or off-screen.
scenarios.name: toScreen returns null for a point on the globe's far side
when: the test calls cesium.toScreen(lat, lng) for a point on the far side of the globe
then: it returns null

scenarios.criterion: cesium.toScreen(lat, lng) returns page coordinates, or null when the point is on the far side of the globe or off-screen.
scenarios.name: toScreen returns null for a point that is visible but off-canvas
when: the test calls cesium.toScreen(lat, lng) for a point that faces the camera but falls outside the canvas bounds
then: it returns null

scenarios.criterion: cesium.clickAt(lat, lng) clicks through page.mouse, and a fixture test shows the globe's pick returned that location within the tolerance metersPerPixelAt gives.
scenarios.name: clickAt clicks through to the correct location near the globe's centre
given: the fixture page has loaded and a pick handler is installed on the globe
when: the test calls cesium.clickAt(lat, lng) for a visible point near the centre of the view
then: the pick handler reports a location within metersPerPixelAt(lat, lng) times two metres of the requested point

scenarios.criterion: cesium.clickAt(lat, lng) clicks through page.mouse, and a fixture test shows the globe's pick returned that location within the tolerance metersPerPixelAt gives.
scenarios.name: clickAt clicks through to the correct location near the horizon
given: the fixture page has loaded and a pick handler is installed on the globe
when: the test calls cesium.clickAt(lat, lng) for a visible point near the horizon
then: the pick handler reports a location within metersPerPixelAt(lat, lng) times two metres of the requested point

scenarios.criterion: cesium.flyTo(lat, lng, heightMeters) moves the camera and waits until settled.
scenarios.name: flyTo moves the camera to the requested destination and waits until settled
when: the test calls cesium.flyTo(lat, lng, heightMeters)
then: the camera's resulting latitude, longitude, and height match the requested destination within tolerance
the call does not resolve until the globe reports settled

scenarios.criterion: distance, lineLength and point-in-circle checks take the globe's radius from the seam rather than assuming Earth's, and are unit-tested in Node without a browser; whether they live in this package or a shared saturday-geo is decided at the design gate.
scenarios.name: Geometry helpers use the globe's own radius instead of assuming Earth's
given: a declared globe radius of 6,000,000 metres, differing from Earth's 6,371,000 metres
when: distance, lineLength, and point-in-circle are computed for the same coordinates once with the declared globe radius and once with Earth's radius, in a Node environment with no browser
then: the two radii produce different results, showing each helper used the radius it was given rather than an assumed Earth radius

scenarios.criterion: The package's test script runs the fixture suite in real Chrome (channel: 'chrome', headed, --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader) and passes with the literal AC9 docker command after dependencies are installed and the package is built; record its output in the delivery record.
scenarios.name: The fixture suite passes in real Chrome via the published docker command
given: dependencies are installed and the package is built
when: the docker command `docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --network none -v "$PWD:/work" saturday-runner:debian bash -lc 'cd /work && pnpm --filter @orieken/saturday-playwright-cesium test'` is run
then: both the Vitest suite and the Playwright chrome-project suite pass with no network access

scenarios.criterion: Each helper's test fails when the fixture's corresponding value changes; for a helper reading nothing from the fixture, a change to the helper's own code that the test catches is the proof instead. Record, per helper, the change made and the failing output in the delivery record.
scenarios.name: Each helper's test fails when its proof value changes
given: a helper under test and, where one exists, the fixture value its test depends on
when: the fixture's corresponding value is deliberately changed, or, for a helper reading no fixed fixture value, the helper's own code is deliberately changed, and the test is re-run
then: the test fails, showing it can detect a real regression, and passes again once the change is reverted

scenarios.criterion: The fixture's static server listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
scenarios.name: The fixture server binds the loopback interface only
given: the fixture's static server is started
then: it binds to 127.0.0.1 and does not accept connections on other interfaces

scenarios.criterion: Every new or changed function has cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line is covered by a test that can fail, and no file outside scope.paths changes except the run's own delivery record under docs/features/saturday-playwright-cesium/.
scenarios.name: Changed code stays within complexity, coverage, and scope limits
given: the implementation for this feature is complete
when: complexity analysis and coverage tooling run against the changed files, and the changed file list is compared against scope.paths
then: every new or changed function has cyclomatic complexity below 7
every changed line is covered by a test proven able to fail
no file outside scope.paths changed, except the feature's own delivery record under docs/features/saturday-playwright-cesium/
